---

zxing-reader.js and zxing_reader.wasm are zxing-wasm 3.1.4's reader build
(dist/iife/reader/index.js and dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm), vendored for
QR transfer (S13), unmodified. The wasm is compiled from zxing-cpp at commit
0b2d9a8fc81f420f369928c24331091ff0525976, which is licensed under the Apache
License, Version 2.0: https://github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp/blob/master/LICENSE
